name: Risen Energy Titan TOPCon 490W
notes: Technology: N-Type TOPCon cells, 108-cell (6x18), bifacial with dual glass (high-transmission AR-coated front + heat-strengthened rear). Runs 490-515W - Risen's current residential/commercial TOPCon platform, positioned as a budget-tier Tier-1 alternative to Jinko, JA Solar and Canadian Solar. Pros: Risen backs it with a 5-year product / 30-year linear power warranty (87.4% guaranteed at year 30, ahead of the older industry-standard 25-year curve), bifacial gain on a suitable mounting, and it is consistently one of the cheapest Tier-1 N-type panels per watt on the market. Cons: the shortest stated product warranty of any panel here (5 years vs 12-25 years elsewhere) even though the power warranty is long, and UK single-unit retail stock is thinner than for the more established brands - it is mostly sold through EU/UK trade distributors rather than dedicated UK retail listings.
